thread:
anya: seeing doubled lines in invoice preview when alias->fallback routes fire during rollout. Example: rico -> rico-quant shows both token rows.

devon: repro on staging. Proxy issues new req_id on fallback; metering keys on req_id so fallback arrives as separate event.

maria: quick mitigation idea: emit canonical_request_id + canonical_model at ingress before any fallback so downstream can dedupe.

liam: schema bump risk. Need consumer opt-in flag (accepts_canonical_id) and migration plan.

ops-eng: lower-friction short-term: aggregator coalescer using fingerprint=(tenant_id|session_id|prompt_prefix_hash) with a 750ms window to merge duplicates behind a feature flag. No producer changes.

anya: plan hybrid: enable coalescer at 2% canary and sample canonical_id at edge 2% to validate. Monitor metrics: billing.preview_dup_fraction and billing.coalescer_merges_per_min.

billing: created ticket BILL-1210 to track migration, reconciliation, and preview-email suppression for canary cohorts.

maria: opening PR with sampling toggle and docs: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9786

devon: will land coalescer behind FF, run perf tests, then run canary. Rollout if preview_dup_fraction < 0.1%.
